verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere documents an official CLI, Wally, with releases on GitHub. It has terminal commands like `wally account whoami` and `wally account usage`, browser-based sign-in that hands a credential to the terminal, and the same CLI running small models offline without an account. Docs also say one command points a tool such as opencode (with `--cloud`) at a model and starts it. Community hands-on failures (segfaults, Homebrew install problems) concern the separate rcli voice tool, not Wally, so they don't contradict this CLI. Missing for 10: a full command reference showing CLI depth, and independent hands-on confirmation of the Wally CLI itself.
